name: Cold-Water Pressure Washer
definition: A professional pressure washer without an integrated water-heating system that uses a pump to deliver water through a rated hose, trigger gun, lance and nozzle within model-specific inlet-temperature, pressure, flow and duty limits.
excludedScope: Machines with an integrated burner or electric water heater
External hot-box modules and unverified heated-water feeds
Water-jet cutting, explosive-atmosphere or specialist surface-removal work without exact approval
headline: Cold-water pressure washer pumps, pressure, flow, nozzles and buyer checks
description: This profile explains cold-water washer boundaries, pump and drive formats, working pressure versus maximum pressure, flow, inlet temperature, spray equipment and site verification.
metaDescription: Cold-water pressure washer guide covering electric and engine types, pumps, pressure, flow, nozzles, models, components and buyer checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not operating, surface, chemical, water-system or safety advice. High-pressure jets can cause severe injury and damage. Confirm the current manual, exact product number, rated accessories, inlet water, utilities, PPE, exclusion zone and local rules before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.evidence: Reviewed official products are identified as cold-water high-pressure cleaners or publish unheated architectures.
keyFacts.scope: Named products; external heaters are excluded.

keyFacts.label: Inlet temperature
keyFacts.value: Cold-water naming does not create one universal inlet limit
keyFacts.evidence: Manufacturer sources publish model-specific inlet-water temperature limits.

keyFacts.label: Comparison basis
keyFacts.value: Working pressure and flow must be compared together
keyFacts.evidence: Official specifications separately report pressure and delivery rate.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match water supply, pressure, flow, pump drive, hose, gun, lance and nozzle
keyFacts.evidence: Official sources use model- and configuration-specific hydraulic and accessory boundaries.
keyFacts.scope: Quoted regional product and actual site.

systemFlow.role: Provides water within flow, pressure, cleanliness and temperature limits.
systemFlow.evidence: Official documentation publishes inlet and filtration requirements.

systemFlow.name: Pump drive
systemFlow.role: Supplies mechanical power to the pump.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturer pages identify electrical and pump-drive systems.
systemFlow.scope: Regional voltage, phase or engine configuration.

systemFlow.name: Pressure generation
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources describe piston pumps, bypass or protective controls.

systemFlow.name: Jet delivery
systemFlow.componentFamily: Rated hose, trigger gun, lance and nozzle
systemFlow.role: Transfers water and forms the selected spray pattern.
systemFlow.evidence: Official manuals and product pages list model-specific spray equipment.

systemFlow.name: Runoff and shutdown
systemFlow.role: Controls contaminated water and leaves the system in its prescribed safe state.
systemFlow.evidence: Safety and manufacturer sources define machine controls; site runoff remains buyer-managed.

variants.name: Single-phase electric mobile
variants.taskScale: Routine commercial work near suitable utilities
variants.operatorRelationship: Operator moves the trolley and manages cables, hoses and lance
variants.spaceConstraints: Circuit, cable, water and drainage routes
variants.limitations: Plug style and current draw vary by market.
variants.evidence: Official ranges include mobile single-phase products.

variants.name: Three-phase electric heavy-duty
variants.taskScale: Longer industrial routes and higher flow configurations
variants.operatorRelationship: Operator works from mobile or fixed industrial equipment
variants.spaceConstraints: Three-phase supply, service access and water capacity
variants.limitations: Higher input power does not prove cleaning result or continuous duty.
variants.evidence: Official sources publish industrial electric models.

variants.name: Engine-driven mobile
variants.taskScale: Remote or construction work without mains power
variants.operatorRelationship: Operator manages engine, fuel, pump and spray system
variants.spaceConstraints: Fuel, exhaust, ventilation, noise and transport controls
variants.limitations: Combustion engines may be prohibited indoors or in confined areas.
variants.evidence: Lavor's official Thermic 9 L data sheet identifies a petrol-engine cold-water professional pressure washer.
variants.scope: Thermic 9 L reviewed configuration; combustion use remains site-specific.

performanceMetrics.name: Working pressure
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Nominal pressure during the stated operating condition
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Working, maximum and permissible pressure can differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not compare maximum pressure with another model's working pressure.

performanceMetrics.name: Delivery rate
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Water volume available for rinsing and soil transport
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Rated and maximum values may use different conditions
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Flow and pressure must be compared as a pair.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official specifications publish flow separately from pressure.

performanceMetrics.name: Inlet water limit
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Temperature and supply mode are model-specific
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not infer hot-water compatibility from a metal pump head or commercial label.

performanceMetrics.name: Nozzle and spray pattern
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Controls jet angle, local impact and coverage
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Included and optional nozzle sets differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A rotary nozzle changes local impact without changing pump rating.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official sources list model-specific nozzles or lances.

performanceMetrics.name: Power and duty
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Supports circuit, generator, fuel and operating-window planning
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Motor input, engine power and pump speed are not directly comparable
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Power alone does not establish duty cycle.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturers publish configuration-specific power and pump data.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Result at working pressure, flow, nozzle and standoff
procurementDecisions.assessment: Specify a result-based trial at the lowest effective settings.
procurementDecisions.basis: Jet impact and rinsing depend on the complete hydraulic and nozzle system.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No normalized cross-brand cleaning test is available.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Record pressure setting, flow, nozzle, distance, time and water use.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm rated hose, gun, lance, nozzle and supply.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources distinguish pressure, flow and accessory boundaries.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Duty cycle, utilities and service support
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming professional naming proves continuous duty
procurementDecisions.assessment: Include setup, hose handling, thermal stops, maintenance and downtime.
procurementDecisions.basis: Machine architecture and site utilities determine availability.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Duty definitions differ or are undisclosed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Request a written duty statement and local parts schedule.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Verify pump, motor protection, inlet filter, seals and service inventory.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official pages disclose architecture but not one normalized duty method.

procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Treating cold-water naming as a universal numerical temperature limit
procurementDecisions.assessment: Use the current manual and written supplier confirmation for the exact product number.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No category-wide feed temperature is established.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Record actual supply temperature and obtain written approval.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm seals, hose, inlet path and pump rating.

engineeringChecks.reason: Hose, gun, lance, coupling and nozzle must contain the machine output.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Verify every component part number and rating against the exact model.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Safety and manufacturer sources define model-specific equipment.

engineeringChecks.reason: Insufficient or unsuitable inlet water can affect operation and pump protection.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Measure available flow, pressure and temperature and confirm filtration.

engineeringChecks.reason: Drive configuration changes circuit, exhaust, fuel and operating controls.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Match voltage, phase, protective device, generator or engine-use plan.

engineeringChecks.reason: Jet impact can damage surfaces and runoff may carry regulated contaminants.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Approve a test area, exclusion zone and disposal path before work.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Safety guidance supports controlled operation; discharge requirements remain site-specific.
